articles.summary: Cryoport Systems was honored with the BioServices Innovation of the Year Award for the 2026 BioTech Breakthrough Awards. Our organization was recognized for being the first supply chain solutions company to receive ISO 21973 certification for advanced therapy logistics, making a meaningful impact on patient access to life-changing treatments worldwide.
articles.title: Cryoport Systems Wins 2026 BioServices Innovation of the Year Award for Industry Milestone in Advanced Therapy Logistics
